text: Record a submitted object's version/hash and owner; retrieval verifies the expected identity/hash and reports mismatch rather than returning it as verified evidence.
criteria: Alter the returned test object's bytes; retrieval reports hash mismatch. A new object version does not change the old review binding.

text: A contributor cannot review their own evidence; accept/reject records identify the exact reviewed version and reason.
criteria: Self-review fails; independent review records exact version/outcome/reason and cannot be overwritten by a duplicate conflict.

text: Only authorized roles retrieve content/provenance and place/release holds; access attempts and accepted actions are distinguishable in audit records.
criteria: Unauthorized retrieval/hold release is denied and auditable without logging content or secrets.

text: Delete study content only after retentionUntil and with no active hold; hold acceptance and deletion authorization serialize against the same evidence state.
criteria: Test before/at retentionUntil, active/released hold, and a concurrent hold/deletion-authorization race; only the accepted serialized outcome occurs.

text: Preserve a content-free disposition tombstone and custody record for retained study evidence; no success is recorded before deletion is confirmed.
criteria: Inject physical deletion failure; no completed disposition is reported until successful retry confirms deletion.

text: For 100 evidence files, reconstruct every review/version/hash chain and run an exhaustive retention/hold decision table.
criteria: Reconstruct all 100 evidence chains and execute the full retention/hold matrix independently of the implementation.
